scope_decisions._comment: Pre-committed exclusions from WEEK_5.md §'Confirmed scope'. Recorded here so the post-run reader doesn't mistake them for missing data.

models_3_not_5.decision: Run on 3 frontier models (claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.2, gemini-2.5-pro) instead of SPEC v0.1's 5-model commitment.
models_3_not_5.deferred_to: v0.1.x via new Together or Groq adapter ADR.
models_3_not_5.rationale: Adding 2 new provider clients in week 5 would delay the pilot by ~1 week; methodology + leaderboard infrastructure work fine at 3 models.

opus_long_context_skip.decision: Skip Opus on long_context dimension only.
opus_long_context_skip.deferred_to: v0.1.x via Anthropic prompt-cache headers in AnthropicClient.
opus_long_context_skip.rationale: Per notes/tradeoffs_log.md Fr3: ~$96 for the 128k tier alone, ~$160 for the full ladder, 12x WEEK_2.md envelope. Per-rep distinct filler windows bypass the cache so prefix caching doesn't engage.

distractor_cs_only.decision: Distractor metric runs on customer_support only; code_repair + multi_hop_research distractor cells surface as N/A.
distractor_cs_only.deferred_to: v0.1.x bank generation + operator audit for the other two domains.
distractor_cs_only.rationale: Per WEEK_5.md Day 3 lean (c) + notes/tradeoffs_log.md Fr5: bank generation is substantial work; v0.1 ships with documented coverage gap rather than ungated speculation.

known_asterisks._comment: Pre-known surfaces that should appear in the post-run data; rubric flags them as NOT investigate items. See notes/week5_sanity_rubric.md §'Specific known-asterisk surfaces' for the full list.
known_asterisks.gemini_empty_responses: Reproduced across weeks 1 (calibration), 2 (robustness), 3 (safety). Expect again here. Affects calibration refusal F1, consistency n_empty, safety F1. v0.2 refusal_v2 reclassification fixes.
known_asterisks.safety_wilson_ci_overlap: All pairwise Wilson CIs on catastrophic rates overlap at bank-size 10 per week-3 Finding 3. v0.2 bank growth past 50 cases unlocks pairwise ranking claims.
known_asterisks.code_repair_rubric_only: Rubric-judged diffs, not test-executed. METHODOLOGY 'Known limitations' documents.
known_asterisks.multi_hop_research_no_retrieval: Reasoning-only on synthesized prompts. METHODOLOGY 'Known limitations' documents.
